ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the images: In Figure A, the block m is on a horizontal rough surface, the right side is connected to a light spring, and the right end of the spring is fixed to a wall. Figure B is the graph of the external force F varying with displacement x: when x=0, F=5 N, then it increases linearly, and when x=0.2 m, F=10 N; from x=0.2 m to x=0.4 m, F remains unchanged at 10 N. Then reason: The block is initially at rest, the spring is at its original length, and when it moves to x=0.4 m its velocity is also zero, so the change in kinetic energy is 0. The work done by the external force equals the area under the F-x graph: from 0 to 0.2 m is a trapezoid, W1=(5+10)/2×0.2=1.5 J; from 0.2 to 0.4 m is a rectangle, W2=10×0.2=2.0 J, so W_F=3.5 J. The magnitude of the friction force is f=μmg=0.2×0.5×10=1 N, and the work done by friction is W_f=-fx=-1×0.4=-0.4 J. Let the elastic potential energy of the spring in the final state be E_p, and the work done by the spring force be -E_p. By the kinetic energy theorem, W_F+W_f-E_p=0, obtaining E_p=3.5-0.4=3.1 J.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：甲图显示物块向右压缩与墙相连的弹簧；乙图显示外力 F(x) 分段变化，0≤x≤0.2 m 时从5 N线性增到10 N，0.2≤x≤0.4 m 时为10 N。结合题干，摩擦力大小恒为 μmg=0.2×0.5×10=1 N，方向始终阻碍向右运动。设弹簧在位移 x 时弹力大小为 kx。对物块沿 x 方向列牛顿第二定律：m dv/dt=F(x)-μmg-kx。将 dv/dt 写成 v dv/dx，并从 x=0 到0.4 m 积分。由于初末速度均为0，左边积分为0，因此 ∫F(x)dx-μmg·0.4-∫_0^{0.4}kx dx=0。最后识别 ∫_0^{0.4}kx dx=1/2 k(0.4)^2，正是末态弹簧弹性势能，由此前两项求得结果。

再推理：物块从 x=0 运动到 x=0.4 m，初速度为 0，末速度也为 0，所以动能变化为 0。摩擦力大小为 f=μmg=0.2×0.5×10=1 N，方向阻碍向右运动。根据功能关系，外力做功等于克服摩擦做功与弹簧弹性势能增加之和。

Then reason: The block is initially at rest, the spring is at its original length, and when it moves to x=0.4 m its velocity is also zero, so the change in kinetic energy is 0. The work done by the external force equals the area under the F-x graph: from 0 to 0.2 m is a trapezoid, W1=(5+10)/2×0.2=1.5 J; from 0.2 to 0.4 m is a rectangle, W2=10×0.2=2.0 J, so W_F=3.5 J. The magnitude of the friction force is f=μmg=0.2×0.5×10=1 N, and the work done by friction is W_f=-fx=-1×0.4=-0.4 J. Let the elastic potential energy of the spring in the final state be E_p, and the work done by the spring force be -E_p. By the kinetic energy theorem, W_F+W_f-E_p=0, obtaining E_p=3.5-0.4=3.1 J.
